metric: Conservative physical line overlay: function span from first decorator through end_lineno, including blank/comment/docstring lines; module counts all physical splitlines. Nested functions also measured separately.
inherited_metric: Also enforce inherited nonblank source-line policy and its structural rules; conservative overlay does not relax them.
interpretation: User explicitly blocks 121 through 180; >180 remains blocked under prior ceiling. No permissive gap.

resolution.REFACTOR_REQUIRED: Stop adding responsibility; identify/extract/configure/map separable work; require LOSSLESS_DECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED and SEMANTIC_PARITY_REQUIRED evidence before continuation.
resolution.BLOCK: Reject artifact; refactor; rerun required gates.

exclusions: Data/JSON/SQL/HTML are not executable Python modules; generated executable code is included; notebook function code is measured. No line-padding suppression.
